viewer_learning.L17: On my computer the layer is open: I can see every part of it — nothing is hidden from me.
viewer_learning.L18: And I can act on it directly — open it, read it, change it — any time, with nobody's permission.
viewer_learning.L19: So the first move is to understand this layer — it is already there, growing, and mine to understand.
viewer_learning.L20: The second move is to build my own — and building it makes it grow.
viewer_learning.L21: And the third is to keep an eye on it — it stays mine because I watch it.

scenes.ending_standard: The Academy ending standard is satisfied inside the piece's own terms: (1) the spoken triad IS the plug (Understand the harness / Build your own harness / Keep an eye on it — the Academy invitation, verbatim canon); (2) the viewer is CARRIED ONWARD visually — the Recommendation Current lands the eye on the workshop door (L19), the newborn node shows the way onward is growth (L20), and the watch orbit continues past the final word (L21); (3) the film ends on a living tableau and a scored fade — no silent card, no freeze.

cast-design-1 contains no Work Trio and no Paper Pair (segment named adaptation 1 precedent): their CAST functions are carried by bands, node behaviour, link behaviour, and the work house's glow. L15's 'sharper' is carried by the kinked link straightening (no paper fold exists to sharpen).
cast-design-1 contains no computer (segment named adaptation 2 precedent): 'on your computer' is carried by the work house and the open web throughout.

CAST L18's hand actions (enlarge, draw out, rearrange) are performed node-side: the node enlarges itself toward the viewer, the scan light reads it, the nodes exchange their own slots. The Thinker does not reach, turn, or gesture — a new pose would be a cast decision for Hadi, not a score improvisation.

owner.variable: §9A.7 / M15 — HARNESS tiles ∩ Model rim contact
owner.question: The HARNESS plaques assemble centred (700,300) and overlap the platform Model's lower rim (the segment build's defect 2, carried as Hadi's call). Keep the contact, or clear it?
options: A — Keep the contact (recommended): tiles draw OVER the Model (z decided in the closure), contact measured at Gate 1 and capped at the bolt–Book occlusion precedent (≤ ~1,400 px²). The word visibly crowns the thing it names; the overlap is small, high in frame, and reads as layering, not collision.

B — Clear it: shift the tiles' centre to (700,452), below the Model's rim and above the ring's top — compresses the tiles against the ring and weakens the assemble-on-'harness' sightline to the sweep.
C — Shrink the Model in Scene 2 (w 300 → 260): changes the blessed staging proportion of the Mechanism Stage for one word's sake.
owner.recommendation: A — keep the contact, with the z-order and the Gate-1 cap written into the score (done in R-2, marked conditional on this ruling).
owner.blocks: Blocks the L8 staging sign-off only; every other line is briefable without it.
